MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 13
   C. 3
   D. 40

2. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 37
   C. 36
   D. 5

3. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 10

4. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 11
   C. 24
   D. 5

5. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/4
   D. 1/2

6. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 15
   C. 21
   D. 17

7. Solve for x: x + 8 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 12
   C. 4
   D. 5

8. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 26

9. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4

10. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 42
   C. 12
   D. 24

11. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 82
   D. 9

12. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 48

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
